title: Locally quasi-finite morphisms are exactly relative dimension zero
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For $x\in X$ let $X_{f(x)}$ be the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] and $\dim_x(X_{f(x)})$ its Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] at the point lying over $x$. Then $f$ is locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite] if and only if $\dim_x(X_{f(x)})=0$ for every $x\in X$ (relative dimension zero).
